name: Trevena Inc.
summary: Trevena Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of novel medicines for severe pain and other central nervous system disorders. Their lead product candidate is Olinvyk (oliceridine) injection, approved in the US for the management of acute pain severe enough to require an intravenous opioid analgesic and for whom alternative treatments are inadequate. Trevena is headquartered in Chesterbrook, Pennsylvania.
